application.root: Destination editor included immutable connector_key in PATCH; canonical DestinationUpdate forbids extra fields.
application.fix: Send name, brand_id and configuration only on edit; preserve the create contract.

application.root: Plain asynchronous Brand Voice/Preset fields did not notify zoneless Angular change detection; POST 201 succeeded while lists remained empty.
application.fix: Notify ChangeDetectorRef after asynchronous loads/actions, including error paths; no backend authority change.
application.regression: Two asynchronous render regressions and actual create/default/duplicate/version/archive browser actions

application.root: Named generic workflow/comparison divs lacked an appropriate ARIA role.
application.fix: Use role=group with the existing accessible names; no axe suppression.
application.regression: Workflow group regression and real axe scans of populated comparison/workflow

application.root: Review serialization forced every GeneratedArtifact into legacy ProductContent; channel-specific Studio content caused ValidationError and HTTP 500, including comparison versions.
application.fix: Keep strict legacy generation validation; expose exact persisted Studio dictionaries in review responses and render all saved fields without invented SEO/caption data. Edits retain the correct field names.
application.regression: Four persisted mixed-schema tests plus translation/review browser actions

application.root: Flipkart/Meesho selectors treated paginated Products/Brands response objects as iterable arrays, producing Angular TypeError.
application.fix: Unwrap canonical items at the HTTP boundary.
application.regression: Two paginated response regressions and populated workspace browser checks

application.root: Legacy product_content offered a Studio translation action despite not being an accepted Studio content type; POST returned 422.
application.fix: Disable that incompatible action with an explanation. Exercise translation with genuinely supported channel-specific Studio content; do not relabel legacy content to force acceptance.
application.regression: Legacy no-submit regression and supported translation browser lineage checks

application.root: Unbroken image checksum/Video fingerprint text overflowed the mobile document. Screenshots establish overflow; it is not assumed to explain every click timeout.
application.fix: Wrap long code/pre identifiers in the relevant existing layouts.
application.regression: Actual 390px screenshots and bounded interaction retests; no physical-device claim

application.root: Wizard repeated the entire total for every channel. Retained traces show INR 250.50 total with two INR 250.50 allocations; the API persisted a blocked plan. No spend occurred.
application.fix: Expose explicit manual channel allocations; omit unknown blanks rather than inserting zero. Reuse the existing canonical budget validator for initial plan input, as for later budget changes.
application.regression: Four budget model cases, two Angular allocation cases and existing marketing-plan API tests

additional_application.root: Parallel events/product-channel projections raced on the same unique audit idempotency key (SQLSTATE23505).
additional_application.fix: Lock the exact owned portfolio row before snapshotting keys/emitting its existing projection; shared audit authority and immutable history are unchanged.
additional_application.regression: Six simultaneous requests plus existing portfolio integration tests

additional_application.root: Trend route contextId was ignored; the page remained unselected or followed a different active journey.
additional_application.fix: Resolve the exact owned context from the route; missing IDs never substitute another context or create new research.
additional_application.regression: Owned/missing deep-link regressions and actual reload/analysis checks

additional_application.root: Destination form was editable before its asynchronous data load completed, allowing later patchValue to overwrite seller input. Retained mobile traces additionally show Save pointer interception and an overflowing form.
additional_application.fix: Render/accept saves only after successful initialization; failed initialization remains blocked. Constrain grid tracks, labels and controls to available form width; use normal browser clicks rather than force-clicking.
additional_application.regression: Early-save rejection and loaded PATCH regression, plus mobile document-width and actual Save/reload assertions

additional_application.root: Bulk image Retry was inside an overflowing mobile table without a focusable horizontal scroll container.
additional_application.fix: Use the existing table-scroll layout with a named keyboard-focusable region.
additional_application.regression: Focusable region regression and actual mobile failed-job Retry

additional_application.root: Populated portfolio dimension limitations failed color contrast; supplier/history scroll regions were not keyboard-focusable.
additional_application.fix: Use the existing dark muted palette and named focusable table regions; no axe-rule suppression.
additional_application.regression: Populated portfolio axe retest, all four browser contexts

additional_application.root: The bulk-image Queue CTA remained enabled after the canonical preview reported missing-source blockers, although the backend rejected ineligible work.
additional_application.fix: Disable Queue and guard its handler while the current preview contains blockers; retain authoritative backend validation.
additional_application.regression: Blocked-preview Angular no-submit test and authenticated missing-source preview browser assertion before valid queue/retry

workflow_gaps.finding: Campaign Video activityId route uses the overview component, which does not read activityId. A focused activity detail/rejection contract is not established.
workflow_gaps.disposition: Retain partial; do not claim a populated overview proves activity-specific navigation.

workflow_gaps.finding: Bulk Video component holds operation identity only in memory and does not expose all canonical retry/cancel/reopen controls.
workflow_gaps.disposition: Canonical API and deterministic worker behavior are separate from missing browser recovery/reload proof.

workflow_gaps.finding: SEO save actions do not establish a complete scoped keyword/tag/history management journey; tag list is not rendered by this component.
workflow_gaps.disposition: Retain partial rather than fabricate a saved-list UI assertion.

harness.finding: Orphaned response waiter could reject after a failed click and terminate Node before later entries ran.
harness.fix: Observe the pending rejection without suppressing its actual awaited assertion; regression executed.

harness.finding: Transient UNKNOWN file-open error interrupted the ledger writer.
harness.fix: Atomic bounded replacement and retry for Windows sharing failures; persistent write failures still fail closed.

harness.finding: Repeated destination names, wrong catalog-vs-marketplace IDs, wrong social content type, inactive/missing-price test Products, unselected current brand, incorrect waiter paths/status expectations, and an absent local Video HUMAN-approval allowlist produced false blockers.
harness.fix: Use exact canonical identities/contracts, unique fixture names, active explicit priced synthetic Products, correct current-brand activation, awaited action completion and safe worker-ID projection. Allow only the existing local feedback-only HUMAN Video review in WP7A4, not provider dispatch or approval bypass.

harness.finding: Initial responsive-width contexts were not touch-emulated. Arbitrary Tab focus-count assertion could fail at the browser chrome boundary.
harness.fix: Final mobile contexts enable isMobile/hasTouch. Focus a visible named control before bounded Tab/Shift+Tab checks; do not claim exhaustive keyboard coverage.

harness.finding: Run 412436d33a219d5f DROP timed out, leaving a signed exact OID tombstone.
harness.fix: After explicit HUMAN approval, existing non-FORCE resume_drop completed in 1.672s with all guards intact. No general recovery authority added.
